data.text: Luke, my family raised sheep here, and I want this pasture feeding our village next year too. Bringing 20 each gives us one payday and leaves us buying feed forever. Ten each leaves 50 hectares, which grows back to 100—so we can each save $10,000 every month instead. I’ll commit to 10, and I’m asking all four of you to agree to that limit. Since everyone’s numbers are revealed afterward, we can check our promises and discuss any overuse openly. Luke, will you change your plan to 10 if the rest of us agree?
